description: This Java class 'TimeoutValueValidator' validates timeout header values by parsing them into a 'DittoDuration'. It throws a 'TimeoutInvalidException' if parsing fails.

classes.name: TimeoutValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates timeout header values by parsing strings into DittoDuration instances, throwing exceptions on invalid formats.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TimeoutValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided header value by attempting to parse it into a DittoDuration, throwing an exception if parsing fails.
